Game Overview

In Tactical Penguin, the core idea is straightforward: defend your penguin colony's fish supply from marauding pelicans in Tactical Penguin. Channel strategic precision and timing to launch missile-equipped penguins, navigating blizzards and shifting winds. Experience relentless, escalating challenges as you safeguard food and survival. Dive into this engaging twist on classic missile defense gameplay!
